title: picker mobile tray when overwhelming
rule: Mobile menu container — popover or tray. Use a tray when the option count would overwhelm a popover.
pass_when: Mobile picker uses popover, or tray when the option count would overwhelm a popover.
fail_when: A large option set is forced into a popover that the count would overwhelm, with no tray.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
